error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Boxplot of CWT ridge lengths... with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are explicitly defined in the caption.
